metadata.name: wrappedfactory
metadata.description: WrappedFactory: permissionless wrap-layer deploys on top of any pump.fun token. Sibling program to wrappedbulls.

instructions.name: claim_treasury
docs: Sweep + drain the bull treasury into the multisig's destination
account. Gated to the program's upgrade authority (which on
mainnet is the wrappedbulls Squads multisig). Enforces the
7-day per-deposit lock by running BullTreasuryState::sweep_expired
before reading the claimable balance, so this ix can never
transfer tokens deposited less than 7 days ago.

accounts.name: factory_config
docs: Factory singleton. Read for the canonical $WBULL mint so we can
verify the destination ATA actually wraps $WBULL.

accounts.name: bull_treasury_state
docs: Bull treasury state. Mutated by the sweep + drain.

accounts.name: wbull_mint
docs: $WBULL mint -- required for the TransferChecked CPI's decimals
argument. Constraint mirrors the factory's canonical mint.

accounts.name: bull_treasury_vault
docs: Treasury's $WBULL ATA. Source of the transfer. Validated by
associated_token derivation against (wbull_mint, treasury_state).

accounts.name: destination_wbull_account
docs: Destination $WBULL account. Must hold the same mint as the
treasury. We do NOT pin its owner -- the multisig may want to
claim to an operating wallet, a vesting contract, a DAO treasury,
or wrap the proceeds into bulls. The multisig's choice of
destination is itself a multisig-signed decision.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Caller -- must be the program upgrade authority. On mainnet this
is the wrappedbulls Squads multisig, so a claim requires the
multisig's signing flow.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program's account, for ProgramData lookup.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: Upgrade authority record. Only the wallet that holds upgrade
authority of THIS deployed program may call.

instructions.name: deploy_collection
docs: Permissionlessly launch a new wrap layer for any pump.fun token.
Atomic sequence (all-or-nothing in one tx):
1. Burn 1,000,000 $WBULL from the deployer's $WBULL account
2. Initialize the WrappedCollection PDA (sandboxed by token_mint)
3. Create the Metaplex Certified Collection NFT for marketplace
recognition
4. Bump FactoryConfig.total_deployments and total_wbull_burned
Inputs are validated before any state is written: name length,
ticker length, supply range, art URI length, tokens_per_wrap > 0.

accounts.name: factory_config
docs: Factory singleton. Read for the canonical $WBULL mint; bumped at
the end with total_deployments + total_wbull_deposited counters.

accounts.name: bull_treasury_state
docs: Bull treasury accounting + token-signing authority PDA. Mutated in
this ix to sweep expired entries + push the new deposit.

accounts.name: bull_treasury_vault
docs: Treasury's $WBULL ATA. Destination of the deploy fee. Validated by
the associated_token derivation: this MUST be the canonical ATA at
(wbull_mint, bull_treasury_state) -- attempting to pass a different
account will fail account-constraint resolution before the handler
runs.

accounts.name: deployer
docs: The deployer. Signs the $WBULL transfer + pays rent for every new
account created in this ix. After this tx, the deployer's wallet
holds the collection NFT (standard Tensor/Magic Eden ownership
pattern).

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: The target pump.fun token. The Factory wraps THIS mint. Pump.fun's
2026 migration moved everything to Token-2022, so we use
InterfaceAccount which transparently accepts either classic SPL or
Token-2022 mints. Read only -- nothing changes on the underlying
token mint.

accounts.name: wbull_mint
docs: $WBULL mint. Required to match the canonical value in FactoryConfig.
Source mint for the 1M deploy fee transfer.

accounts.name: deployer_wbull_account
docs: Deployer's $WBULL token account. Source of the 1M deploy fee.

accounts.name: collection
docs: New WrappedCollection PDA. `init` enforces uniqueness: two
concurrent deploys for the same token_mint cannot both succeed,
and a second deploy on a token that already has a wrap layer
fails with CollectionAlreadyDeployed (anchor's PDA-exists error
surfaces as that variant via our error mapping).

accounts.name: collection_mint
docs: Collection NFT mint. Deterministic PDA per-token: same token_mint
always derives the same collection mint address. decimals=0,
mint+freeze authority is the per-token collection_authority PDA so
the program (not a wallet) signs verify_sized_collection_item
during every wrap.

accounts.name: collection_authority
docs: Per-token collection authority PDA. Signs as Metaplex
update_authority + mint authority for the collection NFT. The
same PDA signs verify_sized_collection_item during every wrap on
this collection.

accounts.name: deployer_collection_ata
docs: Deployer's ATA for the collection NFT. Receives the 1-supply mint.
Holding the collection NFT in the deployer's wallet is the
standard Tensor/Magic Eden pattern and lets the deployer claim
the collection on Creator Hub / Tensor Creator Portal.
init_if_needed because an attacker can pre-create the canonical
ATA (mint + owner are both deterministically derivable from the
token_mint and deployer pubkey) to make plain init fail with
IllegalOwner and grief every deploy. Adoption is safe because
the collection_mint is itself a PDA we initialize this same
instruction -- nobody could have minted into it before now.

accounts.name: collection_metadata
docs: Metaplex metadata account for the collection NFT.

accounts.name: collection_master_edition
docs: Metaplex master edition account for the collection NFT.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Classic SPL Token program. Used for the NFT side (collection_mint
init + mint_to + master edition; Metaplex CreateMasterEditionV3
requires classic SPL).

accounts.name: wbull_token_program
docs: $WBULL-side token program (Interface: classic or Token-2022).
Used for the $WBULL burn CPI. pump.fun migrated to Token-2022 in
2026 so this is almost always Token-2022 in practice.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time Factory setup. Writes the FactoryConfig singleton
with the canonical $WBULL mint that every deploy_collection burns
from. Gated to the program's upgrade authority. After this runs,
the $WBULL mint cannot be changed without a new program upgrade.

accounts.name: bull_treasury_state
docs: The bull treasury accounting + signing-authority PDA. Doubles as
the authority for the bull_treasury_vault ATA so this PDA signs
every claim_treasury token transfer via [b"bull_treasury", bump].

accounts.name: wbull_mint
docs: $WBULL mint -- required for the bull_treasury_vault ATA derivation.
Saved into factory_config so future deploy_collection calls can
verify the deployer's $WBULL account matches this exact mint.

accounts.name: bull_treasury_vault
docs: The treasury's $WBULL holding account. Canonical ATA owned by
the bull_treasury_state PDA. All deploy_collection fees flow in
here; claim_treasury transfers out, signed by treasury_state.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program's account, used to locate its ProgramData.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's upgrade-authority record. Only the wallet that holds
the upgrade authority of THIS deployed program may initialize.
After mainnet handoff the upgrade authority becomes the Squads
multisig, which means future re-initialize attempts (if a hypothetical
upgrade re-enabled this ix) would also require multisig consent.

instructions.name: set_verified
docs: Flip the `verified` flag on a specific WrappedCollection. UX signal
(not security) telling marketplaces + /launches + the SDK that
the protocol multisig has blessed this deployment as the canonical
wrap layer for its target token. Gated to program upgrade
authority -- same Squads multisig that controls every other
admin path. Two-way: pass `verified: false` to un-verify a
deployment that started looking legit and later went sideways.

accounts.name: collection
docs: The deployment whose verified flag is being flipped. Mutable.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Caller. Must be the program upgrade authority -- same gate as
initialize + claim_treasury, so on mainnet this requires the
Squads multisig to consent.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program's account, used to locate its ProgramData.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: Upgrade authority record. Only the wallet currently holding upgrade
authority of THIS deployed program may flip the flag.

instructions.name: unwrap
docs: Unwrap an NFT, draining the vault back to the caller and burning
the NFT. Mirrors wrappedbulls::unwrap_bull but reads the expected
drain amount from the WrappedCollection PDA.

accounts.name: collection
docs: The deployment's WrappedCollection PDA. Mutated at the end for
tier reuse + counter updates.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The unwrapping wallet. Receives the drained tokens AND the rent
reclaimed from closing the vault + BullAsset accounts.

accounts.name: payer_token_account
docs: Caller's token account (destination of the unwrapped tokens).
InterfaceAccount for Token-2022 compatibility.

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: Target token mint (must match collection.token_mint).

accounts.name: nft_mint
docs: The bull's NFT mint. Must match the BullAsset record. After
burn_nft, this account is closed.

accounts.name: nft_mint_authority
docs: Vault authority + NFT mint authority. PDA derived from nft_mint.
Used to sign the vault drain + close.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Vault token account holding the locked tokens. ATA owned by
nft_mint_authority. The constraint requires >= tokens_per_wrap
(not == exactly): if a griefer mints/transfers extra tokens to
this canonical ATA to try to brick a strict-equality check, we
still proceed and drain the FULL balance to the holder. Donating
tokens to the vault is a gift to the holder, not a brick.

accounts.name: payer_nft_account
docs: Caller's NFT ATA. Must hold 1 of nft_mint (proves ownership).
Closed by burn_nft.

accounts.name: bull_asset
docs: BullAsset record. Closed at the end of this ix; rent flows to
caller.

accounts.name: metadata
docs: Metaplex metadata account (closed by burn_nft).

accounts.name: master_edition
docs: Metaplex master edition (closed by burn_nft).

accounts.name: collection_mint
docs: Collection NFT mint (must equal collection.collection_mint).

accounts.name: collection_metadata
docs: Collection NFT's metadata. mut because burn_nft decrements the
sized-collection size counter.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Classic SPL Token program. Used by Metaplex BurnNft on the NFT side.

accounts.name: bulls_token_program
docs: Target-token side (Interface). Used for the vault drain (transfer)
+ close.

instructions.name: wrap
docs: Wrap N $TOKEN of the WrappedCollection's configured token mint
into a fresh NFT. Generic over the underlying token, so the same
handler serves every WrappedX. tokens_per_wrap is read from the
WrappedCollection PDA, not passed by the caller (so the caller
cannot under-lock).

accounts.name: collection
docs: The deployment's WrappedCollection PDA. Read for token_mint,
tokens_per_wrap, art_source, name, ticker, collection_mint. Mutated
at the end for tier accounting + counter bumps.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The wrapping wallet. Pays rent for the new NFT mint, ATAs, and
BullAsset PDA. Signs the token transfer into the vault.

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: Target token mint (must equal collection.token_mint). InterfaceAccount
so this works for both classic SPL and Token-2022 mints.

accounts.name: payer_token_account
docs: Caller's token account. Source of the tokens_per_wrap transfer.

accounts.name: nft_mint
docs: NFT mint for this bull. PDA derived from (token_mint, total_wrapped)
so each wrap gets a unique mint without a caller keypair (same
single-signer pattern wrappedbulls adopted for Phantom warning
elimination). Per-token namespacing prevents collisions between
deployments.

accounts.name: nft_mint_authority
docs: Vault authority + NFT mint authority. PDA derived from nft_mint so
the locked tokens follow the NFT through every marketplace trade.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Vault token account. ATA owned by nft_mint_authority. init_if_needed
for the canonical-ATA grief vector (an attacker can pre-create the
derivable ATA to make plain init fail; adopting an empty one is
safe because unwrap drains the FULL balance).

accounts.name: payer_nft_account
docs: Caller's NFT ATA. Receives the freshly minted 1-supply NFT.

accounts.name: bull_asset
docs: BullAsset record. PDA seeded by (token_mint, tier_index) so per-
deployment tier records cannot collide across deployments.

accounts.name: metadata
docs: Metaplex metadata account for this NFT.

accounts.name: master_edition
docs: Metaplex master edition (caps supply at 1).

accounts.name: collection_mint
docs: Collection NFT mint. Must equal collection.collection_mint.

accounts.name: collection_metadata
docs: Collection NFT's metadata. mut because verify decrements/increments
the sized-collection size counter.

accounts.name: collection_master_edition
docs: Collection NFT's master edition.

accounts.name: collection_authority
docs: Per-token collection authority PDA. Same PDA established by
deploy_collection; signs verify_sized_collection_item.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Classic SPL Token program. Used for the NFT side (mint_to + Metaplex
CreateMasterEditionV3 requires classic SPL).

accounts.name: bulls_token_program
docs: Target-token side (Interface: classic or Token-2022). Used to
transfer tokens_per_wrap from payer to vault.

errors.name: FactoryAlreadyInitialized
errors.msg: Factory has already been initialized

errors.name: NotFactoryAdmin
errors.msg: Caller is not the configured Factory admin (program upgrade authority)

errors.name: WrongWbullMint
errors.msg: Provided $WBULL mint does not match Factory config

errors.name: InsufficientWbullForBurn
errors.msg: Caller's $WBULL balance is below the 1,000,000 deploy-burn threshold

errors.name: InvalidSupplyRange
errors.msg: Max supply must be between 100 and 10,000 inclusive

errors.name: InvalidTokensPerWrap
errors.msg: Tokens-per-wrap must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidName
errors.msg: Wrap layer name must be 1..=32 ASCII characters

errors.name: InvalidTicker
errors.msg: Wrap layer ticker must be 1..=12 ASCII characters

errors.name: InvalidArtUri
errors.msg: Art source URI must be 1..=200 ASCII characters and end with a non-whitespace char

errors.name: CollectionAlreadyDeployed
errors.msg: A wrap layer for this token mint already exists (PDA collision)

errors.name: WrongTokenMint
errors.msg: Token account is not for this collection's configured token mint

errors.name: InsufficientBalance
errors.msg: Caller's balance is below the wrap threshold for this collection

errors.name: MaxSupplyReached
errors.msg: Maximum supply already wrapped for this collection

errors.name: TierOutOfBounds
errors.msg: Tier index out of bounds (must be 1..=max_supply)

errors.name: TierMismatch
errors.msg: Bull asset PDA does not match expected tier index

errors.name: NotNftHolder
errors.msg: Caller does not hold the bull NFT being unwrapped

errors.name: NftMintMismatch
errors.msg: Provided NFT mint does not match the BullAsset record

errors.name: VaultBalanceMismatch
errors.msg: Vault balance is below the expected tokens-per-wrap amount

errors.name: WrongCollection
errors.msg: Provided collection mint does not match this WrappedCollection

errors.name: TreasuryPendingFull
errors.msg: Bull treasury pending queue is at capacity (256). Multisig must claim_treasury to free room.

errors.name: NothingClaimable
errors.msg: Nothing currently claimable in bull treasury after sweeping expired deposits

errors.name: WrongTreasuryState
errors.msg: Provided bull treasury state PDA does not match the expected derivation

errors.name: WrongTreasuryVault
errors.msg: Provided bull treasury vault does not match the expected ATA derivation

fields.name: nft_mint
docs: The NFT mint address (Metaplex NFT representing this bull). The
off-chain renderer reads from here when art_source is BaseUri /
RendererUrl that embeds the mint or tier.

fields.name: tier_index
docs: Tier index 1..=max_supply (the "WrappedDoge #N" public identifier).

fields.name: wrapped_at
docs: Wrap timestamp (unix seconds).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: claimable
docs: Tokens that have already cleared the 7-day lock and are sweepable
by the multisig in a single claim_treasury call.

fields.name: pending
docs: Recent deposits waiting on the 7-day window. Bounded by
PENDING_CAP to keep account size predictable.

fields.name: lifetime_deposited
docs: Lifetime sum of every deposit ever made. Monotonically increasing.
Mirrors FactoryConfig.total_wbull_deposited but lives here so a
treasury reader needs only this account.

fields.name: lifetime_claimed
docs: Lifetime sum of every successful claim. Monotonically increasing.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Forward-compat slack.

types.name: DeployCollectionArgs
docs: Args bundled into one struct so the on-chain wire format stays small
even as v1.1 adds optional banner/social fields. ALL fields here are
validated in the handler before any chain state mutates.

types.name: DepositEntry
docs: Single entry in BullTreasuryState.pending. AnchorSerialize + Copy so
the vec round-trips through the account data cleanly and the
sweep math can drain entries without clone overhead.

fields.name: wbull_mint
docs: $WBULL mint address. Every deploy_collection transfers 1,000,000 of
this exact mint into the bull treasury atomically. Immutable post-init.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin who can update non-economic config fields (reserved for V2).
The deploy cost and supply bounds are NOT in this slot; they are
hard-coded constants so a compromised admin cannot silently lower
the deploy fee.

fields.name: total_deployments
docs: Total number of WrappedCollection deploys ever created. Counter
for telemetry + the /launch landing page stat strip. Saturating
u32 (4B deploys is comically more than realistic).

fields.name: total_wbull_deposited
docs: Total $WBULL deposited into the bull treasury across all deploys
(lifetime, base units). Strictly monotonic. The treasury's CURRENT
balance can be lower than this (after multisig claims) but
total_wbull_deposited never decreases. Field name was previously
total_wbull_burned in pre-pivot drafts; layout is unchanged so
existing test fixtures still deserialize correctly.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Forward-compat slack for fields we have not designed yet (V2 keeper
reward params, governance, etc). Keeps the account size stable so
existing deserializers keep working when we add fields here later.

fields.name: verified
docs: Protocol-multisig-set "this is the canonical wrap layer for this
token" badge. Visible on /launches + via @wrappedbulls/sdk so
holders can distinguish founding-cohort deployments from fan
deploys / scam squats. Default false; flipped via set_verified
gated to the program upgrade authority (= Squads multisig post
mainnet handoff).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Forward-compat slack. Used for fields added in future upgrades
(royalty splits, buy-and-lock treasury balances, governance flags,
etc) without changing the on-chain account size. One byte was
carved out of the original 64 for `verified` above.
